Requirements You aren't encumbered or wearing medium or heavy armor

Effect You dance as freely as the stars above. While in this stance, you can attempt a Performance check instead of an Acrobatics check to [[/act escape skill=performance]] or [[/act tumble-through skill=performance]]. When you succeed at such a check, your stance reaches its zenith. While your dance is at its zenith, your Strikes with agile or finesse weapons and unarmed attacks deal additional force damage equal to the number of weapon damage dice.

Your stance stays at its zenith until the start of your next turn or until you leave the stance, whichever comes first, and you can't bring your stance to its zenith if it's already at its zenith. If you gain more ways to reach the zenith through other feats, these restrictions apply to those methods, too.
